name: TypedTemplateCompiler
purpose: Define one typed compiler structure that every generated language module must expose.

SourceGraph.invariant: Every template is a canonical AST artifact reachable from the graph root.

TypeManifest.invariant: Types and fixed definition targets are explicit compiler inputs and are never inferred from one request value.

TypedProgram.invariant: All symbols, paths, expression types and block inputs are resolved before a language backend runs.

Definition<T>.invariant: html bypasses template execution; data has the fixed input type of the declared target template.

Definitions.fields: one optional Definition<T> field for every declared define key
Definitions.invariant: Generated code cannot select a template target absent from the type manifest.

Input<T>.fields: the fields declared for template T
Input<T>.invariant: Block input precedence is assign, definition.data, block scope.

GeneratedModule.invariant: A block invokes its generated child function directly; callers do not supply a pre-rendered string slot.
